market_question: Will Renan Santos finish in second place in the first round of the 2026 Brazilian presidential election?
reasoning: Renan Santos is a fringe leftist candidate who received only 0.47% of the vote in the 2022 Brazilian presidential election, ranking 7th out of 11 candidates. To finish second in the first round of 2026 would require beating all major candidates from PT, right‑wing parties, and other established alternatives—an event with an extremely low probability. The current 6.6% implied probability is a vast overstatement of his chances.
evidence_points: Santos won 0.47% of valid votes in 2022’s first round, far from second place (Bolsonaro at 43.2%).
He belongs to the small PSOL/MTST movement with negligible national polling and no major party machinery.
Historical first‑round second‑place finishers in Brazil have always been dominant figures from large coalitions; no fringe candidate has come close.
sources_consulted: Polling aggregators and general news on Brazilian 2026 presidential race
